about: Interface strings, area b (see notes/sa-ui.md). OWNER: ui-b. Areas: battle (battle menus), challenge (challenge / feedback screens), learn (Sanskrit prompts, explanations and role labels built in logic-learning.ts), recital (recital toasts), card (verse / word cards), toast (logic toasts). The learn.*Expl / learn.note* / learn.role* explanation keys are Sanskrit-only parts of a challenge explanation: their `en` is a faithful English of the Sanskrit (the English explanation itself is still built in logic-learning.ts, unchanged).

models.source: MW rUpa n. 'any outward appearance, form, shape'; (in gram.) 'any form of a noun or verb (as inflected)'; ṇatva after r like मित्र (रूपाणि)
MW vibhakti f. 'separation, division'; (in gram.) 'inflection of nouns, declension, a case'; i-stem like मति
MW saMdhi m. 'junction, connection'; (in gram.) 'euphonic junction of final and initial letters in grammatical combination'; i-stem without ṇatva like मुनि
MW cUDA-maRi m. 'a jewel worn by men and women on the top of the head' (R.); i-stem like मुनि (the ṇ is in the stem; no further ṇatva)

battle.switch.ctx: battle command menu: switch the active hero (call another hero)

battle.item.ctx: battle command menu: use an item

battle.vs.ctx: battle name bar between the hero and the foe

battle.debates.ctx: duel name bar between the reciter and the opponent

battle.whoForward.ctx: forced switch after the active hero is exhausted

battle.matchBoth.en: {$a} attacks are {$out} against {$f}; its attacks are {$in} against you.
battle.matchBoth.ctx: element matchup hint; {$a}/{$f} = element chips, {$out}/{$in} = battle.strong / weak / even

battle.matchOne.ctx: element matchup hint (the foe's attacks are even)

battle.strong.ctx: matchup word: strong (महत् फलम्, as in the battle line)

challenge.recitalStep.ctx: challenge header: question i of n in a recital

challenge.line.ctx: verse context: which line (pāda) of the verse

challenge.tapOrder.en: Tap the words in verse order.
challenge.tapOrder.ctx: word-order challenge: hint while the answer line is empty

challenge.undo.ctx: word-order challenge: remove the last word

challenge.timeUp.ctx: feedback title: the timer ran out

challenge.youChose.ctx: feedback: the option the player picked

challenge.correctAnswer.ctx: feedback: the right answer (after a wrong one)

learn.lipiPrompt.ctx: challenge prompt: script (lipi) — the same word in the other script

learn.puranaPrompt.en: Which word fills the gap in line {$n} of this verse?
learn.puranaPrompt.sa: पादः {$n} — रिक्ते स्थाने कः शब्दः अस्ति?
learn.puranaPrompt.ctx: challenge prompt: fill in (purana); {$n} = line number

learn.kramaPrompt.en: Arrange the words of line {$n} in the order the verse has them.

learn.vicchedaPrompt.en: How does this joined form split into words?

learn.vibhaktiPrompt.en: Which case or role does this word have in line {$n} of its verse?
learn.vibhaktiPrompt.sa: पादः {$n} — अस्य पदस्य का विभक्तिः? अथवा इदं किं पदम्?

learn.placeholderPrompt.en: The verses are still being gathered. Tap to continue.
learn.placeholderPrompt.sa: श्लोकाः अधुना अपि न लब्धाः। अग्रे गच्छ।

learn.placeholderExpl.en: No verse words are available yet.

learn.arthaExpl.en: {$w}: remember the meaning of this word.

learn.lipiExpl.en: This is a form of the word {$w}. Look at all its syllables carefully.
learn.lipiExpl.sa: एतत् {$w} इति शब्दस्य रूपम्। सर्वाणि अक्षराणि सम्यक् पश्य।

learn.noteSame.en: The verse has this very form too: {$f}.
learn.noteSame.sa: श्लोके अपि {$f} इति एतत् एव रूपम् अस्ति।
learn.noteSame.ctx: explanation (Sanskrit part): the shown form occurs in a verse; {$f} = {f:verse:index}

learn.noteOther.en: In the verse it appears as {$f}.
learn.noteOther.ctx: explanation (Sanskrit part): another form of the word occurs in a verse

learn.puranaExpl.en: The verse has {$f} here. It is a form of the word {$w}.
learn.puranaExpl.sa: श्लोके अत्र {$f} इति पदम् अस्ति। तत् {$w} इति शब्दस्य रूपम्।

learn.kramaExpl.en: In the verse the words stand in this order: {$words}.
learn.kramaExpl.ctx: explanation (Sanskrit part), word-order challenge; {$words} = the line's {f:} forms

learn.vicchedaExpl.en: This joined form has the words {$parts}.

learn.vicchedaShown.en: The correct answer is shown above.
learn.vicchedaShown.ctx: explanation (Sanskrit part), sandhi challenge whose parts are not verse words

learn.explSubject.en: The word {$f} is in the first case (nominative). Its question: who? what?
learn.explSubject.sa: {$f} इति पदे प्रथमा विभक्तिः अस्ति। प्रश्नः — कः? का? किम्?

learn.explObject.en: The word {$f} is in the second case (accusative). Its question: whom? what?
learn.explObject.sa: {$f} इति पदे द्वितीया विभक्तिः अस्ति। प्रश्नः — कम्? काम्? किम्?

learn.explInstrument.en: The word {$f} is in the third case (instrumental). Its question: by whom? with what?
learn.explInstrument.sa: {$f} इति पदे तृतीया विभक्तिः अस्ति। प्रश्नः — केन? कया?

learn.explRecipient.en: The word {$f} is in the fourth case (dative). Its question: to whom? for whom?
learn.explRecipient.sa: {$f} इति पदे चतुर्थी विभक्तिः अस्ति। प्रश्नः — कस्मै? कस्यै?

learn.explSource.en: The word {$f} is in the fifth case (ablative). Its question: from whom? from what?
learn.explSource.sa: {$f} इति पदे पञ्चमी विभक्तिः अस्ति। प्रश्नः — कस्मात्? कस्याः?

learn.explPossessor.en: The word {$f} is in the sixth case (genitive). Its question: whose?
learn.explPossessor.sa: {$f} इति पदे षष्ठी विभक्तिः अस्ति। प्रश्नः — कस्य? कस्याः?

learn.explLocation.en: The word {$f} is in the seventh case (locative). Its question: in whom? where?
learn.explLocation.sa: {$f} इति पदे सप्तमी विभक्तिः अस्ति। प्रश्नः — कस्मिन्? कस्याम्?

learn.explAddress.en: The word {$f} is a vocative. With this word we call a person.
learn.explAddress.sa: {$f} इति पदं सम्बोधनम् अस्ति। अनेन पदेन वयं जनम् आह्वयामः।

learn.explVerb.en: The word {$f} is a verb. Its question: what does one do?
learn.explVerb.sa: {$f} इति पदं क्रियापदम् अस्ति। प्रश्नः — किं करोति?

learn.explIndeclinable.en: The word {$f} is an indeclinable. Its form is always the same.
learn.explIndeclinable.sa: {$f} इति पदम् अव्ययम् अस्ति। तस्य रूपं सदा समानम्।

learn.explModifier.en: The word {$f} is a modifier. Its question: of what kind?
learn.explModifier.sa: {$f} इति पदं विशेषणम् अस्ति। प्रश्नः — कीदृशः? कीदृशम्?

recital.restored.ctx: toast: a recital restored the verse

recital.again.ctx: toast: an already restored verse recited again (passed)

recital.fail.en: {$c} of {$t} correct. Three in four (75%) restores the verse. Try again!
recital.fail.sa: {$c} / {$t} उत्तराणि सम्यक्। यदि चतुर्षु त्रीणि (७५%) सम्यक्, तर्हि श्लोकः पूर्णः भवति। पुनः प्रयतस्व!

recital.cannot.en: This verse cannot be recited yet.
recital.cannot.sa: अधुना एतं श्लोकं पठितुं न शक्नोषि।
recital.cannot.ctx: toast: the recital queue is empty

recital.newMove.ctx: toast: a restored verse unlocks a move; {$who} nominative, {$move} accusative (sa-battle forms)

recital.newMoveEquip.en: New move for {$who}: {$move} (equip it from the Party menu)
recital.newMoveEquip.sa: अधुना {$who} {$move} अपि जानाति! “वीराः” इति पृष्ठे तं मन्त्रं चिनु।
recital.newMoveEquip.ctx: toast: as recital.newMove, the hero already has four moves

recital.newMoveSwap.en: New move for {$who}: {$move}, in place of {$old}
recital.newMoveSwap.ctx: toast (Kathā): a restored verse's astra is equipped in place of a plain move; {$who} nominative, {$move} / {$old} accusative (sa-battle forms)

toast.astraArmed.ctx: toast (Kathā, a v0.4.0 save loaded): an unlocked astra is equipped in place of a plain move; {$who} nominative, {$move} / {$old} accusative

toast.received.ctx: toast: a story gift; {$item} accusative (sa-battle forms.item / toast.itemAcc*)

toast.receivedN.ctx: toast: a story gift of several

toast.itemAccRing.ctx: accusative of the key item kusha_mudrika (sa-battle forms cover battle items only)

toast.itemAccJewel.ctx: accusative of the key item chudamani

toast.noneLeft.ctx: toast: item use refused, none left; {$item} accusative

toast.exhausted.en: {$who} is exhausted. A reviving herb is needed first.
toast.exhausted.sa: {$who} बलं न अस्ति। प्रथमम् ओषधिं देहि।
toast.exhausted.ctx: toast: a healing item on an exhausted hero; {$who} genitive

toast.fullStrength.ctx: toast: a healing item on a hero at full HP; {$who} genitive

toast.notExhausted.ctx: toast: a reviving item on a hero who is not exhausted; {$who} genitive

toast.ppFull.en: Every move of {$who} is already fully charged.

toast.battleOnly.en: {$item} can only be used in battle.

toast.keepSafe.en: {$item} is kept safe for the journey.

toast.well.en: The well water is cool and clear.
toast.well.sa: कूपस्य जलं शीतलं स्वच्छं च अस्ति।

toast.aHero.ctx: a move's hero when none is known (nominative)
